name: Kotodama Zenji
source: A self-proclaimed "inspired man of the quill," Zenji spends each day seeking inspiration. The people around him struggle to understand his unique sensibilities, but he always seems to be in good spirits. Though eccentric, he cares deeply for others and can be a bit of a worrywart.
